_comment: Ratchet config for scripts/codecharta-ratchet.py, run against the CodeCharta map (tempus.cc.json.gz). Three gates: (1) per-file aggregate complexity, (2) per-FUNCTION complexity (not gameable by moving code between files), (3) hotspot (complex AND under-tested). Every number below was MEASURED on this repository — none was carried over from another project. The initial set was measured at v0.19.0; entries added or changed later carry a dated note in the section they belong to, so a re-measured value is never mistaken for the original baseline. Ratchet by LOWERING the numbers as the code improves; RAISING a baseline entry needs review justification.

complexity._default_cap_note: Per-file SUM of function complexity. Every file not listed below must stay <= this. The measured median across the 42 non-test Go files is 9.5 and the highest non-baseline file is internal/domain/belt.go at 25, so 25 is generous for an ordinary file while making an unusually complex NEW file require a reviewed config entry. This gate can be satisfied by splitting a file (the sum moves with the code) — see function_complexity for the ceiling that cannot.
complexity._round1_note: Refactoring round 1 (v0.20.0 -> next): toFeature was split into hourIndex/hourlyValues/enrichWeatherCode/enrichBeaufort and moved to a new feature.go, and app.New's provider wiring and observability setup moved to providers.go and observability.go. openmeteo.go 47->23 and app.go 30->18 dropped below default_cap, so their entries are gone; the relocated mapping logic in feature.go is baselined at 29 (its worst function is 7). The split cost ~5 total file complexity in function overhead and bought a per-function max of 8 instead of 18.

function_complexity._default_cap_note: The single most complex FUNCTION in a file (McCabe). This is the real overall-complexity control: a function keeps its complexity wherever it lives, so moving it between files cannot game this gate — passing requires actually simplifying the function or extracting cohesive sub-functions. No function in the repository exceeds the cap today, which is why the baseline is empty; the highest are openmeteo Fetch and domain/koppen.go at 9-10.
function_complexity._empty_baseline_note: Empty since refactoring round 1: no function in the repository exceeds the cap of 10 any more (the worst are openmeteo Fetch and domain koppen at 9-10). A new entry here means a function was allowed past 10 — it needs a reason in review.

hotspot._note: A file is a hotspot when it is complex AND under-tested; a NEW hotspot fails the build. internal/adapters/http/server.go is the only one left and is grandfathered — visible test debt, not an exemption. Remove it from 'allow' once its coverage improves; the ratchet prints a notice as soon as it no longer qualifies.
hotspot._app_note: internal/app/app.go left this list in refactoring round 1 because its complexity fell to 18, below min_complexity — NOT because it got tested. Its coverage is in fact lower now (43%), since the better-covered wiring moved to providers.go. The testing debt is real and is the subject of the follow-up coverage work; the hotspot gate simply no longer sees it.
